title: An arabinogalactan from Bupleurum chinense DC. attenuates LPS-induced inflammation in RAW264.7 macrophages.
authors: Zheng, Bowen; Jiang, Chenxu; Wang, Zheng; Zhang, Qiuhong; Du, Hang; Huang, Nana; Wang, Jin; Du, Jinhua; Zhang, Daizhou; Sun, Rong; Wang, Daijie
one_liner_zh: 该文研究柴胡阿拉伯半乳聚糖的抗炎活性及TLR4结合机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inflammation is a fundamental defense mechanism of the human body, but its dysregulation can lead to chronic disease. Therefore, identifying natural compounds with anti-inflammatory potential has become particularly important. Natural polysaccharides have received increased interest due to their immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory effects. In this study, we characterized the structure of an arabinogalactan (BCP-WB) derived from Bupleurum chinense DC. (Apiaceae family) with a widely used medicinal plant. Its molecular weight was determined to be 34.4 kDa. Its backbone is predominantly made up of -->6)-beta-D-Galp-(1-->, -->3,6)-beta-D-Galp-(1 --> and -->6)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1 --> linkages, while the side chains are formed by alpha-L-Araf-(1-->, -->5)-alpha-L-Araf-(1 --> and -->3,5)-alpha-L-Araf-(1 --> linkages. The anti-inflammatory activities of BCP-WB were evaluated in LPS-induced RAW264.7 cells and CuSO(4)-induced zebrafish. BCP-WB significantly alleviates inflammatory reaction, including neutrophil dispersion, NO release, and inflammatory cytokine production. Mechanistically, RNA-seq analysis revealed that BCP-WB induces extensive transcriptional reprogramming in macrophages, including downregulation of NF-kappaB, TNF, and cell cycle pathways. Guided by these findings, BCP-WB was further demonstrated to bind directly to TLR4, as validated by molecular docking and SPR assays, which provided kinetic evidence of receptor engagement. This interaction ultimately suppresses the activation of NF-kappaB and MAPK signaling cascades, thereby attenuating inflammatory responses at multiple levels.
abstract_zh: 炎症是人体的一种基本防御机制，但其失调可导致慢性疾病。因此，识别具有抗炎潜力的天然化合物变得尤为重要。天然多糖因其免疫调节和抗炎作用而受到越来越多的关注。在本研究中，我们表征了一种来源于柴胡（Bupleurum chinense DC.，伞形科（Apiaceae））这一广泛使用的药用植物的阿拉伯半乳聚糖（BCP-WB）的结构。其分子量测定为34.4 kDa。其主链主要由-->6)-beta-D-Galp-(1-->、-->3,6)-beta-D-Galp-(1-->和-->6)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->连接组成，而侧链由alpha-L-Araf-(1-->、-->5)-alpha-L-Araf-(1-->和-->3,5)-alpha-L-Araf-(1-->连接形成。在LPS诱导的RAW264.7细胞和CuSO(4)诱导的斑马鱼中评估了BCP-WB的抗炎活性。BCP-WB显著缓解炎症反应，包括中性粒细胞分散、NO释放和炎症细胞因子产生。机制上，RNA-seq分析揭示BCP-WB在巨噬细胞中诱导广泛的转录重编程，包括NF-kappaB、TNF和细胞周期通路的下调。在这些发现的指导下，进一步证明BCP-WB直接结合TLR4，并通过分子对接和SPR实验验证，提供了受体结合的动力学证据。这种相互作用最终抑制NF-kappaB和MAPK信号级联的激活，从而在多个层面减弱炎症反应。
